value.rationale: For a canonical infinitely many-dimensional family, the derivation space gains m−2 exceptional directions in characteristic two, a sharp structural deformation/symmetry transition. The exact count of all invertible derivations identifies field-extension obstructions uniformly in m and p. Unlike a routine isolated small-matrix count, these results give a natural invariant across the entire graded family.
